method: Run each scenario twice with paired subagents (with and without the skill) and grade against the checks. Then measure triggering on the 20 prompts below (14 should trigger, 6 should not); target > 90% correct.

scenarios.prompt: Make me a small 3-row terminal mascot (a cat) with an idle loop and a celebrate animation, and give me a command to preview it.
checks: A rig JSON exists with canvas.rows = 3 and an even sub-pixel grid
Timelines idle (loop) and celebrate exist; every frame has an integer hold
A compiled ANSI player or preview command is given
No quadrant glyphs were hand-typed into the rig

scenarios.prompt: My sprite has a red scarf, a teal body and dark eyes all touching in one spot; the validator says cell-colors. Fix it without losing the scarf. Also make it look right in macOS Terminal.app.
checks: Fix moves pixels so each 2x2 cell holds at most 2 tokens (validator passes), rather than suppressing the check
Explains the bg-fill / 16-color behaviour for Apple Terminal (QUADMOTION_BG_FILL or automatic detection)
Every palette token has rgb and ansi16

scenarios.prompt: Turn my rig into a Claude Code mod that dances while tools run and celebrates when the turn finishes.
checks: events maps tool.call and turn.complete to existing timelines
compile --target claude-mod produced plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/register.tsx, types/index.d.ts
The frame timer is started in session.start, not turn.start
claude plugin validate passes or the agent says how to run it

scenarios.prompt: Rig a 3D character in Blender with IK legs and export a walk cycle as glTF.

should_trigger: make an animated mascot for my CLI
draw a pixel art robot in the terminal with unicode blocks
I want a little creature above the Claude Code prompt that reacts to tool calls
turn this 16x8 pixel grid into quadrant characters
add a blinking idle animation to my terminal logo
export my terminal mascot to an animated SVG
build an Ink component that shows an animated character
